claim_text: DoorDash's status page showed an increase in errors on its Drive endpoints from 11:30 AM ET on Nov 21 and a recovery update at 11:50 AM ET
summary: DoorDash's status page listed a Drive endpoints incident at 11:30 AM ET on Saturday, Nov 21 ('an increase in errors on drive endpoints') and said at 11:50 AM ET: 'We are seeing recovery. Team will continue to monitor.'
detail: Times are the status page's own, relayed by IsDown (which converts them from UTC, 16:30 and 16:50) and Men's Journal. The incident covers the DoorDash Drive API component. Drive is DoorDash's white-label delivery service for businesses, per Men's Journal. We could not open the status page ourselves, so its wording comes from those two relays.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Two independent outlets relay the same status-page entries and times; the status page is the primary source.
notes: status.doordash.com not readable by our fetch; Tier 1 listed but not re-read.

claim_text: DoorDash opened a second status-page incident, titled 'DoorDash Health Degredation', at about 11:33 AM ET, saying 'We are currently investigating this issue'
summary: Three minutes after the Drive entry, DoorDash opened a second status-page incident titled 'DoorDash Health Degredation' (its spelling): 'We are currently investigating this issue.' It was still open at 1:52 PM ET.
detail: Men's Journal describes the incident as being about degraded service. Two status monitors that read DoorDash's official status feed, PulsAPI and FlareWarden, give the title and text. FlareWarden lists its impact as none, and no component is named for it. We still could not open the status page ourselves.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Men's Journal and two monitors relaying DoorDash's own status feed agree on the incident, time and text; we have not read the official page directly, so it stays Reported.
notes: u002: sources s007 and s008 added; Editor-in-Chief kept the label at Reported because relays of the company's feed are not a direct read of the official page or an independent check.

claim_text: More than 12,700 outage reports were filed on Downdetector on Nov 21
summary: Hindustan Times says Downdetector had logged 12,742 reports by the time of writing; Men's Journal says Downdetector showed thousands of reports. A third site (Sportskeeda) says more than 14,000 but says it could not verify the count.
detail: Downdetector counts reports that users submit, not the number of customers affected. Men's Journal gives the mix as 79% app problems, 11% login and 6% checkout at about noon ET. The numbers differ between outlets and we did not read Downdetector.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Hindustan Times gives the 12,742 figure and Men's Journal confirms thousands of reports; both cite Downdetector.

claim_text: Customers saw an error message in the DoorDash app and website: 'Whoops. We experienced an error while executing your request.'
summary: Hindustan Times and Times Now report users across the US seeing 'Whoops. We experienced an error while executing your request. Please try again.' with Retry and Log Out options, and say the app and website were not working.
detail: The accounts come from user posts quoted by the outlets. Some users also reported they could not change a delivery address or log in.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Two outlets describe the same error screen from users' reports.

claim_text: Downdetector user reports began at about 11:02 AM ET
summary: Men's Journal says user reports of DoorDash problems began at 11:02 AM ET, citing Downdetector's own post. Sportskeeda puts the start of the rise at about 11:20 AM.
detail: This is when reports began, not when DoorDash's systems failed. DoorDash's own status entries start at 11:30 AM ET.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Men's Journal cites Downdetector's post for the 11:02 start; Sportskeeda gives a later time.

claim_text: The Drive endpoints incident caused the app and website failures
summary: No source links the Drive API incident on the status page to the consumer app and website errors. Drive is a separate business delivery product.
detail: The two incidents appeared close together in time, but DoorDash has not said how they relate, or whether the second incident (degraded service) is the one that affected customers.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The status entries name the Drive API and a degraded-service incident but do not say which affected the app.

claim_text: The outage was caused by a hack
summary: People on social media asked whether DoorDash was being hacked; Hindustan Times quotes one user asking. No source provides evidence of an attack.
detail: The claim rests on speculation only. No official, security researcher or outlet reports signs of an intrusion, and DoorDash has not described one.
label: Unverified
why_it_supports: Hindustan Times quotes the question from social media; it offers no evidence.

claim_text: DoorDash has said the outage was or was not a cyberattack
summary: We found no DoorDash statement about a cyberattack, in either direction. The status entries give no cause, and Times Now says the root cause has not been disclosed.
detail: This is not a denial. DoorDash has not ruled an attack in or out as far as we found.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the status entries or the outlets we read reports a statement on the cause.

claim_text: The root cause of the outage
summary: DoorDash has not published a cause. The status entries say only that errors increased on Drive endpoints and that a degraded-service incident was being investigated.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Nothing in the status entries or coverage gives a cause.

summary: Neither incident has a Resolved update that we have seen. At 1:52 PM ET all 16 status-page components showed operational, but the 'Health Degredation' incident was still open and the Drive incident was last at 'monitoring'.
detail: FlareWarden read the status page at 12:04 PM ET and saw 'All Systems Operational' at the top, with the Drive incident still open. A component showing operational is not the same as DoorDash marking an incident resolved. Sportskeeda says services appeared to return to normal but does not cite DoorDash.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Two monitors of the official feed show the components operational but both incidents still open.

claim_text: The outage is tied to other outages this month
summary: No source we found links the DoorDash outage to other recent outages or attacks.
detail: A coincidence in timing is not a link, and DoorDash named no outside provider.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Neither the status entries nor the coverage mention any other company or event.
